text.tspan: MCP Apps flow: Dialog Lab (and the colour picker)
The host loads the app's HTML from a ui:// resource, renders it in a sandboxed iframe and relays the app's requests. The app never talks to the server directly.
ui/dialog-lab.ts, bundled to one HTML file
chat UI and model; renders the iframe
A Launch: the host fetches the UI resource, calls the tool and hands the call to the app
B Interaction: the app reaches the server and the model only through the host

pick_color (src/colorPicker.ts, ui://feature-test/color-picker.html) runs steps 1 to 7 the same way; its result returns at once with a requestId.
The answer comes back through the app-only pick_color_submit (steps 8 to 10), then ui/update-model-context and ui/message (11); the model can poll pick_color_result (13).
